tests/container/staged.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cleanup_staged() {
    result=$?
    trap - EXIT INT TERM HUP
    if [[ -e ${marker} || -L ${marker} ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' 'Container writer unresolved: Git state, backup stash and guard are preserved.' >&2
        exit 125
    fi
    unlink "${guard_directory}/git"
    rmdir "${guard_directory}"
    exit "${result}"
}

checkout=$(CDPATH='' cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/../.." && pwd -P)
if [[ ${1:-} == orchestrate ]]; then
    shift
    cd "${checkout}"
    real_git=${STAGED_REAL_GIT:-$(type -P git || true)}
    if [[ -z ${real_git} ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' 'Git is required for staged orchestration.' >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    if [[ ${real_git} != /* ]]; then real_git=${PWD}/${real_git}; fi
    marker=$("${real_git}" -C "${checkout}" --no-optional-locks \
        -c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null \
        rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path container-exec-active)
    if [[ -e ${marker} || -L ${marker} ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' 'Resolve the existing container writer before staging changes.' >&2
        exit 125
    fi
    if ! command -v node >/dev/null || [[ ! -f node_modules/lint-staged/bin/lint-staged.js ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' 'Staged orchestration requires host Node.js and local lint-staged.' >&2
        printf '%s\n' 'Prepare project dependencies through make exec before retrying.' >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    guard_directory=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/staged-git.XXXXXXXX")
    {
        head -n 1 tests/container/staged-git
        printf '# CLEANUP (added %s): Remove after the container writer is resolved.\n' "$(date +%F)"
        tail -n +2 tests/container/staged-git
    } > "${guard_directory}/git"
    chmod 755 "${guard_directory}/git"
    trap cleanup_staged EXIT
    trap 'exit 130' INT
    trap 'exit 143' TERM
    trap 'exit 129' HUP
    export STAGED_REAL_GIT=${real_git} STAGED_GIT_MARKER=${marker}
    export PATH="${guard_directory}:${PATH}"
    node node_modules/lint-staged/bin/lint-staged.js --concurrent false "$@"
    exit $?
fi
if (( $# == 0 )); then
    printf '%s\n' 'Specify a staged formatter.' >&2
    exit 2
fi
formatter=$1
shift
case "${formatter}" in
    prettier|eslint) ;;
    *) printf 'Unsupported staged formatter: %s\n' "${formatter}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

arguments=()
for argument in "$@"; do
    if [[ ${argument} == /* ]]; then
        if [[ ${argument} != "${checkout}/"* ]]; then
            printf '%s\n' 'Staged formatter paths must remain inside the checkout.' >&2
            exit 2
        fi
        relative=${argument#"${checkout}/"}
        parent=$(realpath -m -- "$(dirname -- "${argument}")")
        if [[ ${parent} != "${checkout}" && ${parent} != "${checkout}/"* ]]; then
            printf '%s\n' 'Staged formatter paths must not traverse an external symlink.' >&2
            exit 2
        fi
        if [[ -L ${argument} ]]; then
            printf '%s\n' 'Staged formatters do not follow symbolic links.' >&2
            exit 2
        fi
        case "${relative,,}" in
            .git|.git/*|*/.git/*|.env|.env.*|*/.env|*/.env.*|*.env|.dev.vars|.dev.vars.*|*/.dev.vars|*/.dev.vars.*|\
            .npmrc|*/.npmrc|.pypirc|*/.pypirc|.netrc|*/.netrc|.git-credentials|*/.git-credentials|\
            .private/*|*/.private/*|.ssh/*|*/.ssh/*|.aws/*|*/.aws/*|\
            credentials|credentials.*|*/credentials|*/credentials.*|*.pem|*.key|*.crt|*.cer|*.p12|*.pfx|*.age|*.gpg|*.sops.*)
                printf '%s\n' 'Credential-shaped paths cannot be passed to staged formatters.' >&2
                exit 2
                ;;
        esac
        arguments+=("/work/${relative}")
    else
        arguments+=("${argument}")
    fi
done

exec "${checkout}/tests/container/run" exec "${formatter}" "${arguments[@]}"

tests/container/staged-git.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [[ -z ${STAGED_REAL_GIT:-} || -z ${STAGED_GIT_MARKER:-} ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'The staged Git guard requires its orchestration context.' >&2
    exit 2
fi
if [[ ${STAGED_REAL_GIT} == "$0" ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'The staged Git guard cannot invoke itself.' >&2
    exit 2
fi
if [[ -e ${STAGED_GIT_MARKER} || -L ${STAGED_GIT_MARKER} ]]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'Git operations are blocked while a container writer remains unresolved.' >&2
    exit 125
fi
exec "${STAGED_REAL_GIT}" "$@"
